title: Commitments
dek: The commitments grid: pipe-by-shipper firm capacity on Western Canadian long-haul pipelines, every cell tagged by source tier.

claims.text: Enbridge Canadian Mainline is 100% uncommitted (0 kb/d contracted)
Keystone base system: 585 kb/d committed (~94-99%), ~6-yr volume-weighted remaining term at Dec 31, 2025
Trans Mountain Line 1+2: 707,500 b/d firm (79.5%), rising toward ~801 kb/d at 90% cap effective Jan 1, 2027
CNRL holds 169 kb/d of TMX firm capacity (20-yr); Cenovus ~144 kb/d (press); MEG 20 kb/d (company release)
claims.vintage: CNRL 2024 MD&A/FS notes; Argus Nov 2024; company release Jul 2024

claims.text: CNRL disclosed 77.5 kb/d on Flanagan South and 10 kb/d on Keystone Base (Q1 2025 release); 256.5 kb/d total contracted crude transport
CNRL executed conditional 150-165 kb/d 20-yr US-market transportation agreements, service Q4 2028, carrier unnamed, not recognized as commitments
claims.vintage: CNRL Q2 2026 interim financial statements, Note 16

claims.text: Per-shipper committed volumes are confidential by design on most pipes (TSA NDAs); tariff structure is public, commercial volumes are dark
